# Test Fixtures

## Sample brokerage statement PDFs

`sample_wells_fargo_brokerage.pdf` and `sample_fidelity_netbenefits_401k.pdf`
are **synthetic** documents generated by [`generate_sample_statements.py`](generate_sample_statements.py).
No real brokerage statements were downloaded, opened, or referenced. Names,
account numbers, balances, and dollar values are fabricated; tickers are real
symbols (AAPL, FXAIX, etc.) so the extractor tests can reason about real
instruments.

These fixtures exist to exercise the PDF-import pipeline (LlamaExtract on AWS
Lambda — see `features/FEATURE-portfolio-pdf-import.md`) without committing
real customer data.

## Regenerating

```bash
pip install reportlab
python backend/tests/fixtures/generate_sample_statements.py
```

The script overwrites the existing PDFs in place. Commit both the script and
the resulting PDFs so tests are reproducible and the fixtures are reviewable
in PRs.
